properties.description: Unreleased work after v0.56.0. Two halves of one field report: the CONNECT_TIMEOUT issue (a deliberate refusal reaching an MCP client as a transport timeout, because reflow2 waits exactly as long as the client does) and the third leg the triage rule was owed (a reporting-only detector for a registered report that produced no finding). Named descriptively rather than by version: the version is chosen at cut time, and this epoch existed before the cut did.
properties.name: A refusal arrives before the client gives up — a startup refusal no peer can resolve stops the wait instead of timing out, and a report nobody recorded reading is reported
